scope: Explicit CPU, memory and ephemeral-storage declarations for regular and init containers. The source check sees the raw manifest. Admission sees defaulted resource values. A bounded disk-backed emptyDir probe compares below-limit completion with kubelet container-local ephemeral-storage limit eviction. An upstream kubelet device plugin supplies exactly two synthetic device allocations without physical accelerator claims.
